notes.title: Spit and polish update
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

The game now has updated art: New character sprites for everyone as well as two new characters who are optional love interests.

More choices: branching choices now have can have three choices instead of just two. 

A CG gallery: there are 9 CGs for the games three love interests.

Updated story: the game now has been tweaked to feature new dialog, scenes and endings so as to make it a better overall experience.

Enjoy!
